try: Open {url}. The kanban has the side column (the map and the index faded to tabs) with seven tasks: todo has four (task-8 is dashed: proposed by morrow, not decided), doing has task-3, done has two. Drag "print the claim form" (task-4) onto "doing": a line shows where it lands, it moves at once, and {dir}/state.json now says column "doing", an order, movedBy "user" and movedAt.
Reorder within a column: drag a card above or below another one. Drag the dashed task-8 too: it moves and stays proposed (a move confirms nothing).

The keyboard way: click a card (or Tab to it), then Alt+→ / Alt+← moves it to the next / previous column, Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ moves it up or down. A screen reader hears each move. Alt+arrows never act from the chat input.

Open {url} in a second tab and move a card in one of them: the other follows within about 0.2 s. Then type /why task-3 (or press "why?" on the card): it lists each move, who made it and when, with sources.
